grades.quote: When MXR is in effect at the effective privilege mode where explicit memory access is performed, pointer masking does not apply.
grades.reason: Describes an auxiliary MXR effect on pointer masking, not execute-only page read permissions.

grades.quote: The MXR (Make eXecutable Readable) bit modifies the privilege with which loads access virtual memory. When MXR=0, only loads from pages marked readable (R=1 in Figure 67) will succeed. When MXR=1, loads from pages marked either readable or executable (R=1 or X=1) will succeed. MXR has no effect when page-based virtual memory is not in effect.
grades.reason: Directly explains that MXR=1 permits loads from execute-only pages, whereas MXR=0 requires readable pages.
